style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white, gray and deep sea blue tones, only key objects red. Off the coast of West Africa, 2013. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered.
avoid_en: logos, badges, insignia or emblems of real companies or agencies, names, marks or lettering on ships and equipment, readable text or numbers, detailed national flags, blood, dead bodies, faces resembling real people
